unstructured_remittance_information.description: Unstructured remittance information attached to the transfer. Not all rails support this field.

counterparty.description: Sender of the simulated deposit. Mutually exclusive with `counterparty_id`.

line_2.description: Secondary street address. Optional; omit or send null if not recorded.

state.description: State, province, or region. Optional; omit or send null if not recorded.

counterparty_id.description: ID of an existing counterparty to use as the sender of the simulated deposit. Mutually exclusive with `counterparty`.

rail.description: Payment rail the simulated deposit arrives on.

payout_id.description: Payout whose lifecycle is being simulated.

reason.description: Reason the sandbox provider rejects the payout. Use `invalid_routing_number` for domestic rails and `invalid_account_format` for a SWIFT correspondent rejecting on the beneficiary details.
Reason the receiving bank returns the settled payout.

return_id.description: Return whose lifecycle is being simulated.

reason.description: Reason the sandbox provider rejects the return. Use `invalid_routing_number` for domestic rails and `invalid_account_format` for a SWIFT correspondent rejecting on the beneficiary details.
Reason the receiving bank returns the sent return.

label.description: Human-readable label for the account program.

type.description: Account program type. Simulation supports FBO programs only.

account_program_id.description: Account program whose lifecycle is being simulated.

reason.description: Reason for closing the account program.

destination.description: Fiat financial address to which the residual balance of every frozen account under the program is drained.

account_program_id.description: Account program whose lifecycle is being simulated.

payout_ids.description: Payouts created by the drain. Feed each id to `POST /v1/simulations/payouts/{id}/send` to settle.

label.description: Human-readable label for the operating account.

account_id.description: Account whose lifecycle is being simulated.

destination.description: Fiat financial address to which the residual balance of the frozen account is drained.

account_id.description: Account whose lifecycle is being simulated.

payout_id.description: Payout created by the drain. Feed to `POST /v1/simulations/payouts/{id}/send` to settle.

conversion_id.description: Conversion whose execution is being simulated.

counterparty_id.description: Counterparty whose verification is being simulated.

id.description: Unique identifier of the tracking event.

payout_id.description: ID of the payout this event belongs to.

sequence.description: Gap-free counter per payout, in the order Augustus recorded the events. A gap means you missed a recorded event, such as a dropped webhook. A sequence without gaps does not mean every network step was observed.

milestone.description: Normalized point in the payout journey. New values may be added.

scope.description: How far Augustus can follow the payout: end_to_end when the rail confirms the beneficiary credit, network when it only confirms settlement. New values may be added.

source.description: Where Augustus learned this step: augustus for steps Augustus records itself, swift_gpi for SWIFT gpi statuses, other for any other source. New values may be added.

is_terminal.description: Whether Augustus considers delivery finished. A later event, such as returned, can still follow.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the step happened. Null when the source has no timestamp. Can be out of order with sequence.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when Augustus recorded the event.

value.description: ISO 9362 Bank Identifier Code (8 or 11 characters).

identifier.description: Identifier of the institution, typed by scheme.

institution.description: Institution that acted on or reported this step. Null when unknown.

code.description: Status code reported by the network, such as ACSP, ACSC, ACCC or RJCT.

reason_code.description: Reason code for the status, such as G000. Null when the network reports none.

network_status.description: Raw network status. Null when the step has none.

amount.description: Fee amount as a string decimal (e.g. "10.00").

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the fee.

borne_by.description: Who bears the charges under the payment charge agreement: debtor (OUR), creditor (BEN), shared (SHA), or other for any other agreement. New values may be added.

fee.description: Fee deducted at this step. Null when none was reported.

amount.description: Credited amount as a string decimal (e.g. "100.50").

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the credited amount.

beneficiary_amount.description: Amount credited to the beneficiary. Set only on a credited event, otherwise null.

code.description: Normalized reason code assigned by Augustus. New codes may be added.

description.description: Explanation of the reason code, written by Augustus.
description.example: The beneficiary bank reported the account as closed.

status_reason.description: Reason for the current state. Null when none applies.
